provenance_contract: CellRoles.patch(Some(style)) retains a channel role when that PaintStyle channel is None; it replaces/clears only authored channels. patch(None) clears everything. D8 move_cell preserves vacated-prefix roles by marking Some(reset), and this implementation should follow that established contract. The new helper matches raw pre-dim cells but not subsequent semantic operations. Underline and modifiers are cell style data here; they remain unchanged by either background-only fill, and existing dim_layer later applies its established modifier policy.
